name: ergocalciferol
uses: INDICATIONS AND USAGE Ergocalciferol Capsules, USP is indicated for use in the treatment of hypoparathyroidism, refractory rickets, also known as vitamin D resistant rickets, and familial hypophosphatemia.
pediatric: Pediatric Use Pediatric doses must be individualized ( see DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION ).
contra: CONTRAINDICATIONS Ergocalciferol Capsules, USP is contraindicated in patients with hypercalcemia, malabsorption syndrome, abnormal sensitivity to the toxic effects of vitamin D, and hypervitaminosis D.
interactions: Drug Interactions Mineral oil interferes with the absorption of fat-soluble vitamins, including vitamin D preparations. Administration of thiazide diuretics to hypoparathyroid patients who are concurrently being treated with Ergocalciferol Capsules, USP may cause hypercalcemia.
